DRAFT ENGAGEMENT LETTER: FOR PARTNER REVIEW. NOT TO BE SENT.

SB&P
Date: 2026-10-04
To: Finance Manager, Al-Rawdah Trading Company K.S.C.C.

Dear Finance Manager,

Thank you for contacting SB&P. We understand that you have requested our assistance with the audit of your financial statements and the preparation and filing of your Zakat declaration.

1. Scope of services
1.1 AUD-001 Financial Statement Audit
We will perform an independent audit of your company's financial records to provide an opinion on the accuracy and trustworthiness of your financial statements. Our work will involve testing your internal controls and verifying the figures presented in your accounts to ensure they comply with applicable reporting standards.

1.2 TAX-002 Zakat Declaration
We will prepare your Zakat declaration in accordance with local regulations and Islamic finance principles. Our team will calculate the applicable Zakat amounts based on your financial data and manage the formal submission of the declaration to the relevant authorities.

2. Your responsibilities
- Provide the complete set of financial statements, including the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement for the period under audit.
- Grant our team access to your general ledger, trial balance, and supporting documentation for all significant transactions.
- Provide access to your internal accounting records and any relevant payroll or asset registers required for Zakat calculations.
- Provide authorization for us to submit the final Zakat declaration to the appropriate regulatory bodies.

3. Timeline
We have planned our work to aim for completion before the end of Q1. Meeting this timeline is dependent on the timely receipt of all requested records and documentation from your team.

4. Fees
[FEES: to be completed by the partner]

5. Terms
This letter, once signed by both parties, together with SB&P's general terms of business, forms the agreement between us for the services described above. Any additional services will be agreed separately in writing.

SB&P will treat all information you provide as confidential and will use it only for the purpose of this engagement, except where disclosure is required by law or by a regulator.

The work described in this letter depends on the completeness and accuracy of the information and access you provide. Our conclusions will be based on that information.

Either party may end this engagement by giving written notice. Fees for work already performed remain payable.

Yours sincerely,
[Partner name], for SB&P

scope_accuracy.reason: The draft letter accurately describes exactly the two approved services (AUD-001 and TAX-002) without adding unapproved promises or suggesting additional work. It correctly limits the scope to these specific tasks.

clarity.reason: The draft is completely clear. It uses short, direct sentences and avoids unexplained jargon (e.g., defining 'AUD-001' and 'TAX-002' immediately). The client can easily understand exactly what services will be performed, their specific responsibilities, the timeline, and the terms of the agreement.

tone.reason: The tone is consistently professional, plain, and credible throughout. It avoids flashy language, overpromising results (e.g., it correctly states conclusions depend on client-provided information), and uses appropriate business terminology without slang or excessive salesmanship.

completeness.reason: The draft letter is mostly specific regarding client responsibilities, listing detailed actions required for both the audit (AUD-001) and Zakat preparation (TAX-002). However, the timeline in section 3 is generic ('before the end of Q1') rather than reflecting a specific client deadline or start date, which prevents it from achieving the highest score.
